Dictionary sourcing layer: headword forms, kana/kanji forms and readings in the lexicon shards are JMdict/EDRDG data (CC BY-SA 4.0, upstream source record `edrdg-jmdict`, whose terms permit redistribution with attribution and share-alike) sourced and spot-checked against the read-only jmdict-simplified 3.6.2 mirror. The mirror itself is not redistributed and its own source record forbids that. Gloss wording is ai-drafted, not copied; no dictionary definition text is reproduced. This record exists so downstream users see the ShareAlike obligation on the dictionary-derived layer even though the pack-level content_license (CC-BY-4.0) covers this project's original material.
